name: Podiatry & foot care (category guide)
summary: AHPC podiatrists vs ‘foot spa’ upsells — running injuries, diabetic foot risk, custom orthotics quotes, and when physio should lead instead.
body: Podiatrists (AHPC-registered) assess foot and lower-limb biomechanics, nails, and wounds; they are not the same as beauty foot spas or unregistered ‘orthotic’ stalls. Runners and expat desk workers often bounce between physio and podiatry — ask who owns gait analysis, whether custom orthotics are cast after a diagnosis, and the remake policy if pain continues. Public hospital podiatry exists for medical need; foreigners pay full fees, so private clinics sell speed. Insurers may reimburse allied-health visits under a shared outpatient bucket with physio — check remaining caps. Pair with sports/fitness guides for training-load context. This is a category guide, not a ranked clinic list.
whenToEngage: Running / standing foot pain — podiatry vs physio unclear
Quoted custom orthotics before a written assessment
Need AHPC registration check on a WhatsApp clinic
Outpatient allied-health caps shared with physio
